news.detail: Hill was on the field for 27 of the Ravens' 58 offensive snaps. The running back saw usage as both runner and receiver, providing a fast contrast to Derrick Henry's bulk. It appears Hill may be on track for more consistent complementary opportunities than last season behind Derrick Henry in Baltimor

profile: role: RB2 committee — 13% of BAL carries, 4% of targets, 46% of snaps.
availability: not on the league injury report.
